hero_kpi_rationale: Total payments volume (TPV) is the main driver of Visa's business model: the more transactions grow, the more processing revenue grows.

kpis.signal: Solid growth in payments volume, a key revenue driver.
Strong revenue growth aligned with TPV.
Marginal compression due to exceptional provisions.
Net income stable despite exceptional charges.
258 billion transactions processed, sustained core business growth.

risks.title: Dependence on interchange fee regulation and MDR
Intensified competition from alternative payment networks
Cybersecurity and fraud on the VisaNet network
Dependence on emerging technology adoption (AI, stablecoins)
Risk of global network fragmentation and multi-jurisdiction compliance
Cross-border transaction volume and FX exposure
Regulatory scrutiny on antitrust and merchant fees

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts.

tagline: Uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid
